title: Routine salary payment to an established receiver
summary: A monthly payment of a consistent amount to an employer-linked account seen for three years.
signals: this receiver has been paid before
the amount is in line with what this receiver normally collects
the payment was made during normal hours
the sender still has money left afterwards
resolution: Approved automatically in under a second. No customer contact.
lesson: The overwhelming majority of payments look like this. A fraud system is judged as much on how quietly it handles these as on what it catches.
